name: Memberships
description: Members-only content for WordJS: free and paid tiers, a paywall block that ends a post's free teaser, paid subscriptions through Stripe, Mercado Pago or Wompi (sandbox credentials) verified by signed webhooks, tier changes and cancellation by the member, complimentary memberships granted by the admin, and newsletters that email published posts to members by tier with one-click unsubscribe. Members are the site's own user accounts.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its admin page and its Verso blocks (the paywall and the member account box, in the editor and on public pages).
Read tiers, memberships, processed Stripe events and the plugin's own settings table (the Stripe keys live there, never in options).
Create the plugin tables and record tiers, memberships, checkouts and Stripe event receipts.
Read the non-secret membership configuration and the site address (Stripe return URLs and the webhook URL shown to the admin).
Save the non-secret membership configuration (currency, free sign-up policy).
Tell the content-access filter which levels a signed-in account holds, and find an account by e-mail or login when the admin grants a complimentary membership.
Know when a post is published (the post hooks) and read it to email it to members — the full body only to members who hold its access level, the teaser to everyone else.
Send newsletters to members through the site's mail provider (queued, rate-limited); nothing is sent without one.
Public tier list, the member's own account and checkout endpoints, the signed Stripe webhook, and the admin endpoints.
Add the Membresías entry to the admin sidebar.

Call the payment provider the admin chose, only when its credentials are configured: api.stripe.com (Checkout sessions, subscription changes), api.mercadopago.com (subscriptions) or sandbox.wompi.co (transactions, Nequi payment sources and scheduled renewals).
